THE SMARTROOF WORK STYLE • NO PAVEMENT GUESSWORK

We Never Give Quotations From the Ground.
We Inspect Your Roof First—Then We Quote.

"Three roofers, three completely different prices—and not one of them has been up on the roof." Most roofing estimates are plucked from a generic guide price while standing on your driveway. At Smartroof Construction Ltd, wherever there is safe access, we get up onto your roof, take comprehensive photographs of what actually needs doing, and build a quote tailored specifically to your property.

OUR DIAGNOSTIC PROMISE

"We show you what needs doing—and put a number to it—before anyone gives you a guesswork figure."

When you book a free roof inspection with Smartroof Construction Ltd, our team climbs up onto the roof wherever safe access allows and captures high-resolution photographs of your tiles, battens, valleys, and lead flashing. You keep the inspection images and the report either way—in fact, one of our customers used our roof-level photo report to save £1,000 against unnecessary work quoted from the ground.

STEP 01

Safe On-Roof Inspection

No binoculars or pavement guesswork. Where safe access exists, we get directly onto the roof structure to inspect membranes, battens, and mortar joints first-hand.

STEP 02

Photographic Proof & Report

We take comprehensive photos on your roof so you can see the exact issue with your own eyes. You keep the images and honest report with zero obligation.

STEP 03

CHAS & SafeContractor Execution

Matthew, Nico, and our vetted team work quietly, politely, and punctually—using BBA-approved Cromar Vent3 membranes, graded battens, and code lead.

STEP 04

10-Year Written Guarantees

Every qualifying project is protected by our 10-Year Workmanship Guarantee and 10-Year HomePro Insurance-Backed Guarantee—put in writing before we start.

ABOUT SMARTROOF CONSTRUCTION LTD • EST. APRIL 2020

Built on Roof-Level Honesty, Accredited Safety & 10-Year Protection

Incorporated in April 2020 (UK Company No. 12560584) and operating from Croydon and Coulsdon across London, Surrey, Kent, and West Sussex, Smartroof Construction Ltd combines traditional roofing craftsmanship with complete diagnostic transparency.

Whether restoring a storm-damaged heritage slate porch, managing a complex multi-room insurance restoration for a remote landlord, or stripping and re-roofing a family home with BBA-approved breathable membranes, Matthew, Nico, and our experienced team treat every property with quiet respect—clearing away all debris at the end of each day and backing our work in writing before we start.
